pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description:
Sort cards by one rank up or down to clear pyramid stacks in this golf-themed solitaire game. Players strategically remove cards based on their values, aiming to expose and eliminate all cards from the tableau. The challenge grows with limited moves and hidden cards beneath, rewarding thoughtful sequencing and foresight.

Key Features

• Rank-based card matching  
• Mouse-driven card selection  
• Limited move strategic challenge  
• Progression through pyramid layouts  
• Classic card deck visuals

pages.title: Cave Golf

Navigate tricky underground caverns using precise golf swings and physics-based ball control in this challenge. Players aim to sink the ball into increasingly complex holes scattered through mysterious cave passages, where momentum and angles shape each shot’s success. Levels introduce rocky walls and uneven ground that affect ball trajectory, ramping up the difficulty as play progresses.

• Shot angle and power adjustments  
• Progressive cave level designs  
• Obstacle navigation challenges  
• Underground cavern visual style
